description: Build a Motion Graphics template from a composition (Essential Graphics panel): add layer properties as controls, name the template, open the composition in the Essential Graphics panel, or export it as a .mogrt file. Returns the template's controls

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

folder.description: export: absolute folder for the .mogrt (default the Essential Graphics templates folder)

layers.description: add_property: the layers whose property to add

name.description: add_property: the control's name (default the property name); set_name: the template name

overwrite.description: export: replace an existing file. Default false

property.description: add_property: A property: a shortcut (anchor_point, position, scale, rotation, opacity, x_rotation, y_rotation, orientation, source_text, time_remap, audio_levels) or a path of match names or display names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Effect Parade", "Gaussian Blur", "Blurriness"]

name: manage_motion_graphics_template
title: Manage Motion Graphics Template
